info.syllabusName: Tâm lý học nghề nghiệp (Occupational Psychology)
info.description:
The course Provide knowledge of major theories and issues of Industrial/Occupational Psychology. With this knowledge, the student will be able to understand how to use knowledge gained from this course to develop ways to perform effective HR practices and maintain a harmonious working relationship in the organization and be able to analyze HR related information and issues to produce evaluation and propose strategies for HRM practice.
The I/O psychology will help student to motivate employees and create a collaborative working environment in the organization and to evaluate organizational situation to produce innovative solutions and make implications for effective HRM management.
